system_prompt_style.note: Prompt assembly lives in the agent runtimes (OpenClaw/QwenPaw/Hermes); no prompt-building code in evidence. Optional SOUL.md in Worker packages mentioned.

env_context_strategy.note: Delegated to the agent runtimes; no tool list or template in evidence.

context_compaction.note: No history processor in evidence; handled by the runtimes.

tool_count.note: copaw hooks/tools (filesync, message, projectflow, taskflow) are listed in the file tree, but their contents are not in the evidence.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: declarative MCP on Worker/Manager/Team CRDs (breaking) and on Team Leader
protocol_standardization.note: The system also communicates over the Matrix protocol, which is IM rather than an agent protocol.

loop_primitives.note: Agents react to Matrix room messages. The inner loop belongs to the runtimes (OpenClaw/QwenPaw/Hermes).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Let a Manager break down and track longer-running project work.
planning_granularity.note: The Manager decomposes work and delegates it to Teams and Team Leaders. TeamHarness task/project objects also exist.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Built on a **Manager-Workers architecture**, AgentTeams features a Manager that centrally orchestrates multiple Workers
multi_agent_topology.note: A Team with a Team Leader adds a hierarchical level.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The Manager decides whether to use an existing Worker, create a Worker, or organize a Team.
delegation_mechanism.note: Delegation messages travel over Matrix rooms, which also resemble a message_bus.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The Human can add requirements, correct the direction, or approve decisions during execution.
human_in_loop.note: Steering happens through chat. No per-tool permission gate appears in the evidence. on_plan is the closest value.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Skills Ecosystem**: Workers pull from [skills.sh](https://skills.sh) (80,000+ community skills) on demand.
long_term_memory.note: file_notes: MinIO shared storage persists workspaces and task context.

state_persistence.note: The file tree lists worker_checkpoints.go, but its content is not in the evidence.

cost_controls.note: auto_sleep_controller exists but its content is not in the evidence. Model-provider routing is mentioned only in prose.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Manager and Workers run in separate containers
execution_isolation.note: Kubernetes Pods are also available, and a sandbox/openkruise backend exists.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Manager and Workers run in separate containers
filesystem_access.note: Access is relative to the container. No path allowlist appears in the evidence.

network_policy.note: The docs recommend network policies but show no config surface for them.

permission_model.note: Higress gates model and MCP access per consumer, which is credential-level control rather than per-action authorisation.

tracing.evidence_quote: Read the JSONL files in debug-log/.
tracing.note: Controller metrics are also emitted, and AgentLoop observability integration is mentioned.

replayability.evidence_quote: make replay TASK="Create a Worker named alice for frontend development"
replayability.note: This replays a task prompt, not a recorded trajectory.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Real credentials (API keys, GitHub PATs) stay in the gateway — Workers can't see them
guardrails.note: The file tree lists copaw hooks credential_guard.py, output_sanitizer.py and message_filter.py, but their contents are not shown.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Software delivery, research, content, incident analysis, and long-running project collaboration examples

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Choose your LLM provider (OpenAI-compatible APIs supported)

first_release_date.note: No tag dates in evidence. The README records open-sourcing under a former name on 2026-03-04, and changelog v1.0.1 exists.
